payload.purpose_context: After #596 (felix-admin-capture cron failures from a doctor --fix planted shadow row), kg-automation needs a deterministic verifier the operator runs after OpenClaw upgrades, after Anthropic key rotations, and when sub-agent cron failures appear. The verifier surfaces topology violations (per-agent SQLite rows that override read-through inheritance from main) and drift between the plaintext credential file consumed by non-openclaw Python drivers (felix-doc-auditor-driver, felix-heartbeat-gate) and main's SQLite store. Output is fingerprints and verdicts only; no key values printed. Failures from --check surface as structured operator findings with a copy-pasteable rollback command; state mutations are gated behind an explicit --repair flag.
payload.purpose_tldr: A pre-flight helper that catches per-agent SQLite shadow rows and plaintext/SQLite drift before they manifest as cron-call auth failures.
